text.tspan: PlasRisk: a data-driven, multi-dimensional weighted risk framework for bacterial plasmids
FASTA input → ten biology-driven sub-scores → three-method consensus weights → calibrated score → multi-outcome validation for AMR & One-Health surveillance
Each PSC → vector of 10 bounded scores
identical for train, test and external sets
(pairwise DeLong). Weights fixed on train only.
only the composite stratifies all four outcomes at once
five core dimensions match the full ten (ΔAUC ≤ .001)
biocide/metal load adds signal beyond ARGs alone
